items.title: Broadcom Makes More AI Money Than AMD—So Why Is AMD’s Stock Crushing It?
items.summary: One chip giant books far more AI revenue, yet its stock sinks while its smaller rival soars. Investors are betting on a growth curve, but cash flow, inventory, and a December earnings date could change who looks smarter.

items.title: He was right about AI and still lost $35 billion
items.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner turned $225 million into a $45 billion fund in under two years by betting on everything AI would need. Then 4x leverage and a brutal July cost him $35 billion from the peak. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the essay, the bets, the margin calls and Citadel's block trade, and whether he can run it back.

items.title: Why Is Advanced Micro Devices Stock Rallying Today?
items.summary: Shares of Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) surged 5. 1% in pre-market trading on Friday, supported by a broader recovery across artificial intelligence and semiconductor stocks and an extension to the deadline for Chinese restrictions on key semiconductor manufacturing materials.

items.title: AMD Stock Gets A Downgrade From Erste Group – Analyst Flags Valuation Concerns, Low Potential For Share Gains
items.summary: Erste Group analyst Hans Engel noted AMD's expected revenue acceleration, supported by demand for its EPYC server processors and AI GPUs.
